# CaptureKit

CaptureKit captures webpage screenshots, extracts structured web content, crawls pages, and analyzes websites with AI.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/capturekit/.

## Actions

- **Analyze Webpage** (read-only): Analyze a webpage with AI to identify its summary, value proposition, features, categories, use cases, audience, and optional custom fields.
- **Capture Webpage** (read-only): Capture a webpage as an image or PDF and return a downloadable file reference.
- **Extract Webpage Content** (read-only): Extract webpage metadata and links, optionally including rendered HTML, Markdown, sitemap data, or cleaned main content.
- **Fetch Page HTML** (read-only): Fetch a webpage's raw HTML without browser rendering for fast scraping, audits, or monitoring.
- **Get Usage** (read-only): Return the connected workspace's current CaptureKit allowance, usage, API-key status, quotas, and effective rate limits.
